# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 52 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_052_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 52

**1** His disciples said to him: "Twenty-four prophets spoke in Israel, and every one of them was speaking about you."

**2** He said: "You've been ignoring the living one standing right in front of you and talking about people who are dead."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Every one of them was speaking about you" — the claim rendered as a complete fulfillment assertion
- "Standing right in front of you" — the immediacy of Jesus's presence emphasized
- "People who are dead" — the prophets are just dead people; the living one is here
